texts.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。对于旁观者而言，看上去任何外部势力想要抗衡帝国的联合舰队力量都无异于痴人说梦，但是接下来的战斗才会决定最终的结果。
texts.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. To many observers, it seems unfathomable that any outside power could hope to prevail against the combined might of the Imperium, but the coming battles will determine the outcome.

texts.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。这个失落帝国已经延续了近千年，然而[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]却满怀自信，认为帝国的联合舰队力量能够让它在年轻种族面前俯首称臣。
texts.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. This Fallen Empire has endured for millennia, yet the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] seems confident that the combined might of the Imperium will be enough to finally bring it under the heel of the younger races.
